title: Augmented race track
description: The RACE-READY track object the sim actually consumes: a TrackBuilder.buildTrack() output (schema'd by track.schema.json) AUGMENTED with the host's game-side layer — resolved furniture (hazards, pads, boxes, poles, bananas), identity (cup, trackId), and per-race inputs (totalLaps, seed). The host assembles it in two equivalent places: public/display/main.js buildEntry (cup + trackId, then TrackBuilder.resolveFurniture) with the race then stamping totalLaps + seed, and scripts/record-trace.mjs buildRaceTrack (trackId + totalLaps + seed, then resolveFurniture) for golden traces. The engine (public/display/engine/Game.js) reads exactly `centerline`, `length`, `roadWidth`, `totalLaps`, `hazards`, `pads`, `boxes`, `poles`, `bananas`, `seed`; `cup`/`trackId` are identity for theming (renderer-side). scripts/export-track-data.mjs dumps this object as canonical JSON — the byte-for-byte fixture the C++ TrackBuilder + furniture-resolve port diffs against. All coordinates are world units, right-handed, +Y up. Furniture arclengths `s` are resolved from authored fraction-of-lap positions (u in [0, 1)) against the built `length`, so they lie in [0, length). The built-track geometry fields below reference track.schema.json rather than re-describing it; the AUGMENTATION fields are defined in full here.

version.description: CONTRACT_VERSION stamp (public/display/engine/contract.js). Inherited from buildTrack(); the augmentation never restamps it.

cup.description: Cup id the track belongs to (e.g. 'beach', 'rooftop'). Identity for renderer biome theming; the sim does not read it. Set by buildEntry from the catalogue; buildRaceTrack omits it, so a trace-built track has no `cup` — this schema requires it because the export mirrors the full game-side object main.js hands the engine.

trackId.description: Registry id (e.g. 'skysnake'). Identity for per-track theme patches and, crucially, the deterministic scatter RNG seed (buildScenery/buildLandmarks seed their rand streams from it). NOT `track.id`. Stamped in every golden-trace header; the sim itself does not read it.

totalLaps.description: Race length in laps (default 3). A per-race input, not a builder output; the engine reads it for lap counting and the finish line.

seed.description: Per-race 32-bit seed the HOST draws (Math.random in main.js at race start; fixed by the export/recorder for determinism). The engine's item-roll RNG consumes mulberry32(seed); each AI bot derives its own stream from it. The one machine-varying field in a live race — the export pins it (default 1) so fixtures are byte-stable.

hazards.description: Oil slicks, resolved from the descriptor's `oils`. Read by the engine (spin-out detection) and the renderer (puddle + cones). Empty on tracks without oils.

pads.description: Boost pads: authored disc pads (from the descriptor's `pads`) PLUS one auto strip pad per loopStarts entry (a full-width launch band at each vertical-loop mouth, so a loop is always entered on boost). Two shapes — disc and strip.

boxes.description: Item boxes, resolved from the descriptor's `boxes`. The snapshot's `boxes` boolean[] is index-aligned with this list (true = available).

poles.description: Solid collision poles: authored poles (from the descriptor's `poles`) CONCATENATED with the builder's autoPoles (ghost collision proxies for pillars/loop shafts standing in a drivable corridor). Read by the engine (push-out), the AI (dodge), and — for non-ghost poles — the renderer. Empty on every shipped track today.

bananas.description: Pre-seeded bananas, resolved from the descriptor's `bananas`. Dev tracks only (shared/devTracks.js); the engine seeds them live at race start and respawns them after each hit. Empty on every shipped track.

s.description: Resolved arclength in [0, length). World units.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset from the centerline; positive = right of travel.

radius.description: Spin-out trigger radius. World units. Defaults to roadWidth x 0.2 when the descriptor omits it.

cones.description: RENDERER-ONLY cone layout carried through verbatim; the engine ignores it. Optional (absent on most oils); shape is renderer policy, not part of the sim contract.

pad.description: A boost pad in one of two shapes: a radial disc (authored) or a longitudinal strip (auto loop-launch). The engine dispatches on the presence of `shape: 'strip'`.

s.description: Resolved arclength in [0, length). World units.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset; positive = right of travel.

radius.description: Boost trigger radius. World units. Defaults to roadWidth x 0.18 when the descriptor omits it.

s.description: Arclength of the strip CENTRE (loop entry minus halfLen), wrapped to [0, length). World units.

shape.description: Marks a longitudinal band the engine treats as a rectangle across the lane, not a disc.

halfLen.description: Half the along-track length of the strip. World units.

halfWidth.description: Half the across-track width of the strip (loop mouth width / 2). World units.

s.description: Resolved arclength in [0, length). World units.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset; positive = right of travel.

radius.description: Pickup trigger radius. World units. Defaults to roadWidth x 0.09 when the descriptor omits it (kept small so a boosted car cannot tunnel through).

s.description: Resolved arclength in [0, length) for authored poles; autoPoles carry the crossing's closest-abeam sample arclength. World units.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset; positive = right of travel.

radius.description: Collision radius. World units. Authored poles default to 0.45.

ghost.description: Present and true ONLY on poles merged in from autoPoles: the renderer must not draw them (the pillar/shaft they proxy is already the visual). Absent on authored poles.

s.description: Resolved arclength in [0, length). World units.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset; positive = right of travel.
